question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
    lr.year,
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
    ds.points AS driver_points,
    c.name AS constructor_name,
    cs.points AS constructor_points
FROM last_race lr
JOIN driver_standings ds ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
JOIN constructor_standings cs ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE ds.position = 1 AND cs.position = 1
ORDER BY lr.year
OFFSET 50

-- Verify 2021 constructor standings at last race
SELECT cs.constructor_id, c.name, cs.points, cs.position
FROM constructor_standings cs
JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE r.year = 2021 AND cs.race_id = (SELECT MAX(race_id) FROM races WHERE year = 2021)
ORDER BY cs.position
LIMIT 5
